description: Empty answers: first question should be Stage 1 Q1 (applies_in_own_name)
notes: With no answers provided the bank must return the very first question in stage/order sequence.

description: All Stage-1 fields answered True: next question should be first Stage-2 question (PMUY-Q05)
notes: Stage-1 complete, no exclusion fired; engine should advance to Stage 2.

description: Early exit: applicant_is_woman=False triggers LIKELY_NOT_ELIGIBLE; get_next_question returns None
notes: R01 hard exclusion: non-woman applicant is immediately disqualified when stop_on_exclusion=True.

description: No early exit: applicant_is_woman=False set but stop_on_exclusion=False; progression continues
notes: With stop_on_exclusion=False the bank must NOT bail out early; next unanswered field is age_18_or_above (Q03).

description: Unknown answer (household_has_lpg=None) must not be skipped; Q05 should still be returned
notes: None must never be coerced to False; the bank must surface Q05 as the next unanswered question.

description: All 21 engine fields answered: interview complete, get_next_question returns None
notes: All 21 engine fields are answered; bank must return None indicating interview is complete.

description: Stage-4 readiness fields answered but eligibility fields all present: interview complete
notes: Stage-4 questions belong to dimension readiness; with all engine fields answered the bank returns None regardless.

description: Lookup by ID: get_question('PMUY-Q01') returns correct definition
notes: Direct ID lookup must return a QuestionDefinition with matching question_id, stage, and engine_field.

description: Stage listing: get_stage_questions(1) returns exactly 4 Stage-1 questions in order
notes: Stage 1 has Q01-Q04 (applies_in_own_name, applicant_is_woman, age_18_or_above, citizen_and_resident).

description: Localization: get_text('hi') returns non-empty Hindi text different from English text for Q01
notes: Hindi and English texts must both be non-empty and must differ from each other.

description: Early exit via income-tax exclusion: pays_income_tax=True triggers LIKELY_NOT_ELIGIBLE
notes: D03 deprivation exclusion (pays_income_tax=True) should cause early exit; bank returns None.

description: citizen_and_resident=None (unknown): bank must return Q04 as next question, not skip it
notes: None must never be coerced to False or treated as answered. citizen_and_resident remains the next required question.
